recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片五格中可見多顆漿細胞：偏心圓核、豐富的深藍色胞質與核旁淡染區（hof），其中一顆為雙核漿細胞，部分胞質有細小空泡；左下格另有細胞陷在粉紫色無定形物質中。
features: Plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, clumped chromatin and abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof
Binucleate plasma cell (upper left panel) and some larger plasma cells with more open chromatin
Occasional fine cytoplasmic vacuoles; classic flame cells with magenta cytoplasmic rims are not convincingly seen
Background maturing granulocytes, lymphocytes and red cells
One field with a lobulated-nucleus cell (likely megakaryocyte) surrounded by pale pink-purple amorphous material
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (composite of five fields) shows plasma cells among maturing granulocytes and lymphocytes. The plasma cells have eccentric round nuclei with clumped to more open chromatin, abundant basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hofs and occasional fine vacuoles; a binucleate form is present, and several cells are larger than mature plasma cells. Classic flame cells are not clearly identified in these fields. One field shows a cell with a lobulated nucleus embedded in pale pink-purple amorphous material. Selected fields do not allow a plasma cell percentage, and clonality should be established by flow cytometry or kappa/lambda staining. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell infiltrate in the setting of immunoglobulin light-chain amyloidosis.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are small, mature and polytypic, whereas binucleation, larger immature forms and light-chain restriction favor a clonal process.
Osteoblasts are larger, occur in clusters and have a pale zone separated from rather than abutting the nucleus.
Shows a spectrum from small lymphocytes through plasmacytoid lymphocytes to plasma cells with CD20 expression and MYD88 L265P, rather than a pure plasma cell population.
